mentions.name: Retro-computing gaming mouse
mentions.description: This retro-style gaming mouse is designed for retro-computing platforms including Amiga, Atari, and C64, supporting several protocol variants as well as USB. It includes a scroll wheel read using extended protocols introduced by recent adaptors from USB, and a configuration interface.
mentions.audience: Retro-computing users of Amiga, Atari, and C64 systems
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm designing a retro-style gaming mouse for retro-computing: Amiga, Atari, C64, and several protocol variants. It also has USB.
It has a scroll wheel: read using extended protocols introduced by recent adaptors from USB, and a configuration interface.
